unification.c1: Here you can set the mode the unification will work in; options: 'full': uses the exact json base files without changes; 'replace': replaces instead of adds, when remove is available; 'no_add': doesn't add new items only replaces and removes originals, uses the same logic as 'replace'. Default: full
unification.c2: This is a list of mod priorities used if mode is replace or no_add; uses alphabatical order if not provided
unification.c3: Here you can overwrite the mod chosen for a specific material if mode is replace or no_add; syntax: {material: mod}
unification.c4: Setting this to true, will disable the creation of new recipes and will only add recipes that have been removed (so it acts as a replacement of recipes). Default: false
unification.c5: If replace_recipes is set to true, this will still add recipes for the specified recipe types
unification.c6: Here recipe types can be configured to never add new recipes, in some cases these recipes can still exist if being replaced using .replaceInput/.replaceOutput; is prioritized over recipe_types_to_keep
unification.c7: Here you can enable weither overhouled recipes for mystical agriculture seed growing in botany pots should be added, or the orginal values should be kept. Default: true
unification.c8: Here you can enable weither failed item replacements should be added as a new item instead, also affects the modes 'replace' and 'no_add' by allowing materials_types from remove to also be replaced again. Default: true
unification.c9: Here you can enable weither the material_type check for mod specific materials should be disabled (e.g. for crushed_ore from create). Default: false
unification.c10: Here you can enable or disable weither gems textures should be replaced. Default: true
unification.c11: Here you can enable or disable weither textures should be replaced at all; overwrites replace_gem_textures if false. Default: true
unification.c12: Which resource loader to use for textures; options: 'lmr'; 'kubejs'. Default: lmr

ores.c1: Weither ores should be added at all. Default: true
ores.c2: Weither other ores including generation, tags and JEI should be disabled. Set to null to not interfere with configs/defaults and false to load config defaults for generating ores and adding tags to all ores. Default: true
ores.c3: Weither the metal ores should drop itself (true) or raw ores (false). Default: false
ores.c4: Weither the metal should be affected by fortune, disabled when dropping the ore itself. Default: true
ores.c5: Weither the metal should be affected by silk touch, disabled when dropping the ore itself. Default: true
ores.c6: Enables raw ores ore processing, this also affects weither pieces are turned into raw ores (true) or the ore iteself (false). Default: true
ores.c7: Gives raw ores ore processing a lower output than when processing the actual ore, this mimicks ore processing for mods in newer game versions. Default: true
ores.c8: Weither the gem ores should drop itself (true) or gems (false). Default: false
ores.c9: Weither the gem should be affected by fortune, disabled when dropping the ore itself. Default: true
ores.c10: Weither the gem should be affected by silk touch, disabled when dropping the ore itself. Default: true
ores.c11: Here you can modify the ore drop dimension multiplier for the ores

advanced.c1: Here you can set the material types that should be registered as a block. Only change this if you know what you are doing!
